keyEvents.text: Goal! Viktoria Plzen 1, Benfica 0. Patrik Hrosovsky (Viktoria Plzen) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lukás Cerv.
Goal! Viktoria Plzen 2, Benfica 0. Prince Adu (Viktoria Plzen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Christophe Kabongo.
Goal! Viktoria Plzen 3, Benfica 0. Christophe Kabongo (Viktoria Plzen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
First Half ends, Viktoria Plzen 3, Benfica 0.
Substitution, Benfica. Heorhiy Sudakov replaces Enzo Barrenechea.
Goal! Viktoria Plzen 4, Benfica 0. Christophe Kabongo (Viktoria Plzen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Patrik Hrosovsky following a fast break.
Substitution, Benfica. João Palhinha replaces Manu Silva.
Substitution, Benfica. Andreas Schjelderup replaces Rafa.
Substitution, Benfica. Claudio Echeverri replaces Dodi Lukébakio.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Denis Visinsky replaces Amar Memic.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Stefan Pirgic replaces Lukás Cerv.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Tomás Ladra replaces Christophe Kabongo.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Matej Vydra replaces Prince Adu.
Adam Gabriel (Viktoria Plzen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Andreas Schjelderup (Benfica).
Andreas Schjelderup (Benfica) is shown the yellow card.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Alexandr Sojka replaces Patrik Hrosovsky.
Substitution, Benfica. Jhon Durán replaces Vangelis Pavlidis.
Second Half ends, Viktoria Plzen 4, Benfica 0.
